payload.body: dc found one older defect in project.rs, which your bank touches: Project::thread_ids (project.rs:3040-3047 at 084547f52) returns an empty list on any read_dir error, and filter_map(Result::ok) drops an entry it cannot read. That breaks No Silent Errors, so it rides your bank, as hv decision 104 took older defects in touched files into dc's second bank. A missing canon directory may still mean no threads: you hold the meaning. Add it as one commit after your END, run one more clippy on a Desk slot, then bank v1 with it and report. dc's other item for you, the hand-built authority: None in facade.rs, is already gone at your tip.
